title: Headless TTW Picking Up the Trail (MQ06): from the Citadel after Galaxy News Radio's end (MQ05 200) to the player inside Vault 87 (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins where The Waters of Life (MQ05) ends: its stage 200 [observed] stops MQ05, starts MQ06 and sets its stage 0 (which sets 5: objective 5, go with Doctor Li to the Citadel). Set here directly so this chain runs alone; MQ05's earlier stages are given as done without their scripts.
Doctor Li in the Citadel's lab says she must tell Rothchild and Lyons (her stage-5 line).

The swing bridge as ttw-mq03-scientific-pursuits leaves it (issue #2847): this chain starts from a given state in which it was never extended, so its two navmeshes (0x0A0BE880, 0x0A0BE87F, Initially Disabled) are still off and no walk joins the shore and the ship. The player has the Security Intercom extend it, as in MQ03, before walking on board.

Stand-in for Elder Lyons' talk with Li in the lab (his AI package MQ06ElderTalktoLi; its end script [observed] sets DoctorLiRef.CitadelForceGreet 1). The AI has to carry the scene out, so the package's end is played here.
The Vault-Tec terminal in the archives: DC Area Vault Listings, Vault 87, Equipment Issuances (its script [observed] sets stage 30).
Stand-in for Rothchild's walk to the map in the lab (his package after the EVP the line's end script asks for): he is put at MQ06RothchildMapMarker; the player follows.
Travel stand-in: to Little Lamplight's gate, where Mayor MacCready stops the player.

In the same conversation: after his greeting MacCready already offers "Can I come in?" (LLMacCreadyCanIComeIn) [observed, batch 2026-11-16]. Ended and begun again, he had gone behind Little Lamplight's gate, which lets only the kids' faction through (its OnActivate, SCPT 0x0006823A [observed]), and the player could not reach him.

MacCready's end script has him say LLLMacCreadyMainGateYell to Stacey; when that line is done, his script's SayToDone block [observed] gives the player access, opens the front gate and sets MQ06 60 (Vault 87 through Murder Pass).
Stand-in for the walk through Little Lamplight, the back door and Murder Pass into Vault 87: the player goes to the vault cell (Vault87c), which MQ06's script [observed] watches for stage 200.

Little Lamplight's back door (to Murder Pass): its terminal MQ06BackDoorTerminalRef says "The terminal is not powered." until MQ06.dbcomputeron is 2 (SCPT 0x0A003A17 [observed]). Joseph's line 0x0A003A0B ("Sure, if you want.") sets it to 1 and his package MQ06JosephActivateTerminal's end sets 2 [observed, Fallout3.esm]; the walk there is his AI (its end stands in).
